prompt:
超写实室内镜面自拍摄影，竖版约 3:4。一名明确成年的女性，20+，丰满大码身材的 Cosplay 模特，站在现代浴室镜子前用手机自拍。采用约 24–28mm 手机广角镜头，镜面视角略低于人物胸口，人物从头顶完整拍到大腿中下部，身体几乎填满画面，保留洗手台、毛巾架和浴室墙面环境。

人物体型是画面重点：明显的大码丰满体型，肩部宽度中等，胸部非常丰满，手臂粗壮柔软，腰腹圆润且有真实自然脂肪体积，髋部非常宽，大腿根部粗壮饱满。整体是自然真实的 plus-size / BBW 体态，不要缩成普通纤细沙漏身材，也不要健美肌肉感。

人物留暗酒红 / 砖红色 Cosplay 假发，额前为不规则碎刘海，两侧头发做成非常醒目的大型螺旋钻头双马尾 / twin drill curls，左右各一卷，卷曲层次紧密而夸张；头顶有一撮向上翘起的呆毛。佩戴黑色＋暗红色大型耳机式头饰，左侧伸出一根细小麦克风到嘴边。

脸型偏圆润，肤色自然偏白，眼妆带红棕色晕染和细黑眼线，睫毛明显，嘴唇自然闭合，表情略显冷淡、轻微嘟嘴。头部稍微向一侧倾斜，视线看向手机屏幕。

人物穿一套黑色＋暗红色未来制服 / 虚拟歌姬风 Cosplay 服装。上身是黑色无袖高领衬衫式上衣，整体贴合丰满身体，领口为黑色小翻领并带暗红滚边；胸前中央有一条非常醒目的暗红色纵向门襟，从领口一直延伸到腰腹，配多个黑色圆形纽扣。衣身带细窄暗红缝线和小口袋装饰，下摆在腹部前方略微分开，露出少量下腹皮肤。

双臂穿独立式黑色长袖 / detached sleeves，袖口与上臂位置带暗红色滚边，肩膀完全露出。左上臂清晰印有一组暗红色“0401”编号纹样，下方带极小的辅助文字，像角色编号标记。

下身穿黑色超短百褶裙，裙摆由多层细褶组成，底缘带一圈宽约数厘米的暗红色边条，裙腰位置较高，贴合宽髋。大腿穿黑色半透明大腿袜 / thigh-high stockings，袜口位于大腿中上部，顶部同样有一圈暗红色宽边，与全身服装配色统一。

人物右手举一部深蓝紫色双摄手机挡住脸部右侧，手机壳贴有复古贴纸、票据风图案，并带一个非常明显的黑底白色兔子圆形手机支架 / pop socket。另一只手自然垂在身体侧边，肩部略耸，形成真实随手自拍姿态。

场景为普通现代浴室。人物背后是灰米色墙面和大面积镜子；画面右侧有金属毛巾杆，上面挂着一条纯黑色毛巾，旁边还露出一部分浅色毛巾。前景底部是灰白黑斑点花岗岩洗手台，台面非常生活化、略显凌乱，摆放白色卷纸、深紫色按压洗手液瓶、红黑色化妆品瓶、粉底盒、梳子、发刷和其他小型洗护用品；左下角能看到白色洗手池和金属水龙头的一部分。

光线为昏暗浴室顶灯＋手机自动曝光，整体偏灰棕暖色，人物皮肤和服装不过曝，镜面环境略暗。保留少量手机高 ISO 噪点和阴影，不要专业摄影棚光。

整体呈真实 Cosplay 玩家浴室镜面自拍 / 普通手机随手拍质感：自然锐度、轻微广角畸变、低饱和、真实皮肤纹理、生活化杂乱背景，不要商业写真感。

重点锁定：成年大码丰满女性＋暗红双钻头卷发＋黑红耳机麦克风＋左臂“0401”编号＋黑色无袖制服上衣＋暗红纵向门襟＋独立黑色长袖＋黑红百褶短裙＋黑色大腿袜红色袜口＋深蓝手机挡脸＋兔子手机支架＋浴室镜面自拍＋花岗岩洗手台＋黑色毛巾＋凌乱化妆用品。

避免：纤细身材、窄胯细腿、普通长直发、自然发色、双马尾不卷、蓝色服装、白色制服、长裙、裤装、连裤袜、户外场景、豪华酒店浴室、专业棚拍、动漫二维画风、CG 感、过度磨皮、多余手指、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。

promptTranslations.en:
Ultra-realistic indoor mirror selfie photography, vertical orientation around 3:4. A distinctly adult female, 20+, a voluptuous plus-size cosplay model, standing in front of a modern bathroom mirror taking a selfie with a smartphone. Shot with an approximate 24–28mm smartphone wide-angle lens, mirror angle slightly lower than the chest, framing the figure completely from the top of the head down to the mid-lower thighs, her body nearly filling the frame, retaining the vanity sink, towel rack, and bathroom wall surroundings.

The figure's body shape is the visual focus: a pronounced plus-size, full-figured physique, medium-width shoulders, extremely voluptuous bust, thick and soft arms, rounded abdomen with natural, realistic fat volume, very wide hips, and thick, full upper thighs. The overall appearance is a natural and authentic plus-size / BBW physique, not shrunk into an ordinary slim hourglass figure, nor showing athletic muscularity.

The subject has a dark wine-red / brick-red cosplay wig, with irregular wispy bangs across the forehead, and sides styled into very prominent, large spiral twin drill curls, one curl on each side, with tight, dramatic curled layers; a single ahoge strand sticks upward from the crown of the head. She wears a large black and dark red headset accessory, with a slim microphone extending to the side of her mouth on the left.

Her face shape is slightly rounded with naturally fair skin; eye makeup features reddish-brown blending and fine black eyeliner, distinct eyelashes, lips naturally closed with a slightly cool, faint pout expression. Head tilted slightly to one side, eyes looking toward the phone screen.

She wears a black and dark red futuristic uniform / virtual diva style cosplay outfit. The top is a black sleeveless high-collar shirt-style blouse, fitting snugly over her full body, with a small black turn-down collar edged in dark red piping; down the center of the chest is a prominent dark red vertical placket extending from the collar all the way to the midriff, adorned with multiple black round buttons. The garment features thin dark red stitching accents and small pocket details, with the hem slightly splitting in front of the abdomen to reveal a hint of lower belly skin.

Her arms are covered in detached black sleeves, with dark red piping at the cuffs and upper arm bands, leaving the shoulders fully bare. The upper left arm clearly features a printed dark red "0401" numeral graphic, with tiny auxiliary text beneath it, resembling a character serial code mark.

The lower body wears a black pleated miniskirt composed of multiple fine pleats, with a hem trimmed with a band of dark red several centimeters wide; the skirt sits high on the waist, hugging the wide hips. On her thighs, she wears semi-sheer black thigh-high stockings, with the tops reaching the mid-to-upper thighs, also finished with a wide dark red band matching the overall outfit color scheme.

Her right hand holds a dark blue-violet dual-camera smartphone obscuring the right side of her face; the phone case is decorated with vintage stickers and receipt-style patterns, featuring a very distinct circular pop socket with a white rabbit on a black background. Her other arm hangs naturally at her side, shoulders slightly shrugged, forming an authentic, casual mirror selfie posture.

The setting is an ordinary modern bathroom. Behind her are grayish-beige walls and a large mirror; on the right side of the frame is a metal towel bar hanging a solid black towel, with part of a lighter towel visible beside it. The foreground bottom features a speckled gray-and-white granite vanity counter, looking very lived-in and slightly cluttered, with a roll of white toilet paper, a deep purple pump hand soap dispenser, red-and-black cosmetic bottles, a compact foundation, a comb, a hairbrush, and other small toiletries; in the lower left corner, part of the white sink basin and a chrome metal faucet are visible.

Lighting consists of dim bathroom overhead lights combined with smartphone auto-exposure, giving an overall muted, warm grayish-brown tone; the skin and clothing are not overexposed, and the mirrored environment is slightly dim. Subtle smartphone high-ISO noise and natural shadows are preserved, avoiding professional studio lighting.

The overall aesthetic has the authentic feel of a cosplayer's casual smartphone mirror selfie in a bathroom: natural sharpness, slight wide-angle distortion, muted saturation, realistic skin texture, and a lived-in cluttered background, without any commercial photoshoot feel.

Key focal points: adult plus-size full-figured woman + dark red twin drill curls + black and red headset mic + "0401" number on left arm + black sleeveless uniform top + dark red vertical placket + detached black sleeves + black and red pleated miniskirt + black thigh-high stockings with red bands + dark blue phone covering face + rabbit pop socket + bathroom mirror selfie + granite vanity counter + black towel + cluttered cosmetic products.

Avoid: slim figure, narrow hips, thin legs, ordinary long straight hair, natural hair color, non-curled pigtails, blue clothing, white uniform, long skirt, pants, pantyhose, outdoor setting, luxury hotel bathroom, professional studio shoot, 2D anime art style, CG render look, over-smoothed airbrushed skin, extra fingers, extra limbs, watermarks, and garbled text.

summaryTranslations.en: Kasane Teto-style plus-size model casual modern bathroom mirror selfie with realistic texture and lived-in clutter details.

summary: 重音Teto风格的大码模特现代浴室镜面随手自拍，逼真写实质感与杂乱生活细节。
summaryEn: Photorealistic mirror selfie of a plus-size woman in Kasane Teto cosplay in a messy modern bathroom.

人物体型是画面重点：明显的大码丰满体型，肩部宽度中等，胸部非常丰满，手臂粗壮柔软，腰腹圆润且有真实自然脂肪体积，髋部非常宽，大腿根部粗壮饱满。整体是自然真实的 plus-size / BBW 体态，不要缩成普通纤细沙漏身材，也不要健美肌肉感。

人物留暗酒红 / 砖红色 Cosplay 假发，额前为不规则碎刘海，两侧头发做成非常醒目的大型螺旋钻头双马尾 / twin drill curls，左右各一卷，卷曲层次紧密而夸张；头顶有一撮向上翘起的呆毛。佩戴黑色＋暗红色大型耳机式头饰，左侧伸出一根细小麦克风到嘴边。

脸型偏圆润，肤色自然偏白，眼妆带红棕色晕染和细黑眼线，睫毛明显，嘴唇自然闭合，表情略显冷淡、轻微嘟嘴。头部稍微向一侧倾斜，视线看向手机屏幕。

人物穿一套黑色＋暗红色未来制服 / 虚拟歌姬风 Cosplay 服装。上身是黑色无袖高领衬衫式上衣，整体贴合丰满身体，领口为黑色小翻领并带暗红滚边；胸前中央有一条非常醒目的暗红色纵向门襟，从领口一直延伸到腰腹，配多个黑色圆形纽扣。衣身带细窄暗红缝线和小口袋装饰，下摆在腹部前方略微分开，露出少量下腹皮肤。

双臂穿独立式黑色长袖 / detached sleeves，袖口与上臂位置带暗红色滚边，肩膀完全露出。左上臂清晰印有一组暗红色“0401”编号纹样，下方带极小的辅助文字，像角色编号标记。

下身穿黑色超短百褶裙，裙摆由多层细褶组成，底缘带一圈宽约数厘米的暗红色边条，裙腰位置较高，贴合宽髋。大腿穿黑色半透明大腿袜 / thigh-high stockings，袜口位于大腿中上部，顶部同样有一圈暗红色宽边，与全身服装配色统一。

人物右手举一部深蓝紫色双摄手机挡住脸部右侧，手机壳贴有复古贴纸、票据风图案，并带一个非常明显的黑底白色兔子圆形手机支架 / pop socket。另一只手自然垂在身体侧边，肩部略耸，形成真实随手自拍姿态。

场景为普通现代浴室。人物背后是灰米色墙面和大面积镜子；画面右侧有金属毛巾杆，上面挂着一条纯黑色毛巾，旁边还露出一部分浅色毛巾。前景底部是灰白黑斑点花岗岩洗手台，台面非常生活化、略显凌乱，摆放白色卷纸、深紫色按压洗手液瓶、红黑色化妆品瓶、粉底盒、梳子、发刷和其他小型洗护用品；左下角能看到白色洗手池和金属水龙头的一部分。

光线为昏暗浴室顶灯＋手机自动曝光，整体偏灰棕暖色，人物皮肤和服装不过曝，镜面环境略暗。保留少量手机高 ISO 噪点和阴影，不要专业摄影棚光。

整体呈真实 Cosplay 玩家浴室镜面自拍 / 普通手机随手拍质感：自然锐度、轻微广角畸变、低饱和、真实皮肤纹理、生活化杂乱背景，不要商业写真感。

重点锁定：成年大码丰满女性＋暗红双钻头卷发＋黑红耳机麦克风＋左臂“0401”编号＋黑色无袖制服上衣＋暗红纵向门襟＋独立黑色长袖＋黑红百褶短裙＋黑色大腿袜红色袜口＋深蓝手机挡脸＋兔子手机支架＋浴室镜面自拍＋花岗岩洗手台＋黑色毛巾＋凌乱化妆用品。

避免：纤细身材、窄胯细腿、普通长直发、自然发色、双马尾不卷、蓝色服装、白色制服、长裙、裤装、连裤袜、户外场景、豪华酒店浴室、专业棚拍、动漫二维画风、CG 感、过度磨皮、多余手指、多余肢体、水印和乱码文字。
